title: CSV toast conflates not_found vs conflict — partial-success UX lacks distinction
scope: apps/web/src/api/queries.ts useBatchUpdateFindings onSettled toast + apps/web/src/pages/findings-page.tsx bulk action handlers
note: The bulk PATCH response exposes not_found[] and conflict[] arrays distinctly, but the UI toast summarizes them together. Future improvement: split toast lines or add a persistent banner listing conflict IDs separately from not_found IDs.

title: Extract CSV utilities from findings-page.tsx to keep page under 250-line cap
note: Move CSV helpers to apps/web/src/lib/findings-csv.ts, similar to findings-lifecycle.ts. Makes page ≤250 lines and helpers reusable/testable.

title: Codegen should emit concrete BatchUpdateFindingsRequest.patch struct instead of serde_json::Value
note: Runtime enforces the contract via hand-rolled BatchFindingPatch helper. Codegen gap is technical debt; extract patch into a standalone schema or use $ref to a strongly-typed object so Rust and TS both get concrete types.

resolution.note: Extracted finding-batch-patch.schema.json; codegen now emits FindingBatchPatch concrete struct instead of serde_json::Value; handler updated to direct field access.

title: Add test for mid-batch internal error path (partial apply visibility)
note: Current loop aborts on internal DB error after some IDs may have been updated. This matches the plan's 'loop, not transaction' design but lacks a test verifying partial persistence + 5xx response. Add a test with a mocked DAO error mid-loop.
